description.zh:
升配的网关规格。可升配的规格可以通过DescribeGatewayModificationClasses接口查询。可能值：

- Basic：基础型。

- Standard：标准型。

- Enhanced：增强型。

- Advanced：性能型。
description.en:
The gateway class to which you want to upgrade. You can call the DescribeGatewayModificationClasses operation to query the available gateway classes. Valid values:

- Basic

- Standard

- Enhanced

- Advanced

descriptions.zh:
### 接口说明

调用该接口时，您需要注意：

<props="china">- 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云存储网关产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=5176.144914.752642.btn2.1fea7d70I6QIr5&aly_as=C81M1m5N#/hcs_sgw/detail)。</props>
<props="intl">- 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云存储网关产品的收费方式。</props>

- 如果您的网关为包年包月类型，即预付费时，您必须通过接口返回的购买链接进行购买，才能完成网关升配。

- 你可以通过DescribeGatewayModificationClasses接口查询指定线上网关可升配的规格信息。

- 只能升级线上网关可升配规格的规格，且线上网关只能升配不能降配。
descriptions.en:
### Description

Note the following when you call this operation:

<props="china">

- Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=5176.144914.752642.btn2.1fea7d70I6QIr5\&aly_as=C81M1m5N#/hcs_sgw/detail) of Cloud Storage Gateway.

</props>


<props="intl">

- Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the pricing of Cloud Storage Gateway.

</props>


- If your gateway is a subscription instance, you must use the purchase URL returned in the response to complete the upgrade.

- You can call the DescribeGatewayModificationClasses operation to query the gateway classes to which you can upgrade a specified online gateway.

- You can only upgrade an online gateway. You cannot downgrade a gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw modify-gateway-class --gateway-id gw-0001xv7580031yzun000 --gateway-class Enhanced --region cn-hangzhou
